components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The advancing and sharing action: a copper rectangle with top and bottom rules and two rotated side ornaments. The light focus outline appears during keyboard navigation only.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height:56px; padding:0 24px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; position:relative; border:0; border-top:1px solid #d5b28f; border-bottom:1px solid #d5b28f; border-radius:0; color:#1a1716; background:#bd9b7d; font:400 17px/1 MedievalSharp,Georgia,serif; letter-spacing:.025em; cursor:pointer; transition:background .2s ease,color .2s ease,border-color .2s ease,transform .2s ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { color:#171719; background:#d8b496; border-color:#f0d0aa; transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-button-primary:active:not(:disabled) { transform:translateY(0); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #e9c6a3; outline-offset:4px; } .ds-button-primary:disabled { opacity:.45; background:#6e6259; border-color:#807064; color:#dfd3c4; cursor:not-allowed; } .ds-button-primary .ds-button-corner { position:absolute; top:50%; width:1.45rem; height:1.45rem; border-bottom:1px solid #b89578; border-left:1px solid #b89578; pointer-events:none; transition:background .2s ease,border-color .2s ease; } .ds-button-primary .ds-button-corner::before,.ds-button-primary .ds-button-corner::after { content:""; position:absolute; transition:background .2s ease,border-color .2s ease; } .ds-button-primary .ds-button-corner::before { top:calc(1rem - 1px); left:calc(-.4rem - 1px); width:.75rem; height:.75rem; border:1px solid #b89578; } .ds-button-primary .ds-button-corner::after { top:calc(1rem - 1px); left:-1px; width:.5rem; height:.5rem; background:#b89578; } .ds-button-primary .ds-button-corner.ds-left { left:-.75rem; transform:translateY(-50%) rotate(45deg); } .ds-button-primary .ds-button-corner.ds-right { right:-.75rem; transform:translateY(-50%) rotate(-135deg); } .ds-button-primary:hover .ds-button-corner,.ds-button-primary:hover .ds-button-corner::before { background:#d8b496; }

components.name: Secondary Button

components.name: RPG Frame
components.description: A dark panel with a fine copper border and four square corners with extended lines.
components.html: O poartă apare în mijlocul orașului.
components.css: .ds-frame { position:relative; padding:32px; border:1px solid #b89578; color:#e7d2b9; background:linear-gradient(145deg,#24201e,#1d1b1b 65%); box-shadow:0 18px 36px #0004; font:400 27px/1.2 MedievalSharp,Georgia,serif; } .ds-frame-corner { width:.5rem; height:.5rem; border:1px solid #b89578; position:absolute; z-index:3; pointer-events:none; } .ds-frame-corner::after,.ds-frame-corner::before { content:""; position:absolute; } .ds-frame-corner::after { width:2rem; height:calc(1rem - 1px); } .ds-frame-corner::before { width:calc(1rem - 1px); height:2rem; } .ds-frame-corner.ds-left { left:-.5rem; } .ds-frame-corner.ds-left::after { left:calc(-2px + 1rem); border-left:1px solid #b89578; } .ds-frame-corner.ds-left::before { left:-1px; border-left:1px solid #b89578; } .ds-frame-corner.ds-right { right:-.5rem; } .ds-frame-corner.ds-right::after { right:calc(-2px + 1rem); border-right:1px solid #b89578; } .ds-frame-corner.ds-right::before { right:-1px; border-right:1px solid #b89578; } .ds-frame-corner.ds-top { top:-.5rem; } .ds-frame-corner.ds-top::after { top:-1px; border-top:1px solid #b89578; } .ds-frame-corner.ds-top::before { top:calc(-2px + 1rem); border-top:1px solid #b89578; } .ds-frame-corner.ds-bottom { bottom:-.5rem; } .ds-frame-corner.ds-bottom::after { bottom:-1px; border-bottom:1px solid #b89578; } .ds-frame-corner.ds-bottom::before { bottom:calc(-2px + 1rem); border-bottom:1px solid #b89578; }

components.name: Answer Choice
components.description: A full-width square radio choice with a letter tile and warm border. Keyboard focus is outlined; pointer focus is not.
components.css: .ds-answer { min-height:70px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:16px; padding:12px 18px; position:relative; border:1px solid #6c5548; color:#dfc8af; background:#252120; cursor:pointer; font:400 17px/1.45 MedievalSharp,Georgia,serif; transition:border-color .18s ease,background .18s ease,box-shadow .18s ease; } .ds-answer:hover { background:#332923; border-color:#c2a083; } .ds-answer:has(input:focus-visible) { outline:2px solid #e9c6a3; outline-offset:4px; } .ds-answer input { position:absolute; opacity:0; width:1px; height:1px; } .ds-answer-letter { width:35px; height:35px; flex:0 0 35px; display:grid; place-items:center; border:1px solid #806756; color:#c9a98c; background:#1b1a1a; } .ds-answer-text { flex:1; }

components.name: Selected Answer
components.description: A selected square answer with a translucent sheen and a clipped four-span brown-to-gold running border. Reduced motion shows a static gold border.
components.css: .ds-answer-selected { min-height:70px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:16px; padding:12px 18px; position:relative; border:1px solid #856548; color:#dfc8af; background:#3b2e27; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #60452f; cursor:pointer; font:400 17px/1.45 MedievalSharp,Georgia,serif; } .ds-answer-selected::before { content:""; position:absolute; z-index:1; top:2px; left:2px; bottom:2px; width:50%; background:rgba(255,255,255,.05); pointer-events:none; } .ds-answer-selected:has(input:focus-visible) { outline:2px solid #e9c6a3; outline-offset:4px; } .ds-answer-selected input { position:absolute; opacity:0; width:1px; height:1px; } .ds-answer-selected-letter { width:35px; height:35px; flex:0 0 35px; display:grid; place-items:center; border:1px solid #d2ad8b; color:#181718; background:#b99475; } .ds-answer-selected-text { flex:1; } .ds-answer-running-light { position:absolute; z-index:2; inset:0; display:block; overflow:hidden; pointer-events:none; } .ds-answer-running-light span { position:absolute; display:block; } .ds-answer-running-light span:nth-child(1) { top:0; left:0; width:100%; height:2px; background:linear-gradient(to right,#3b2e27,#dfb76f); animation:ds-running-light-top 2s linear infinite; animation-delay:1s; } .ds-answer-running-light span:nth-child(2) { top:0; right:0; width:2px; height:100%; background:linear-gradient(to bottom,#3b2e27,#dfb76f); animation:ds-running-light-right 2s linear infinite; animation-delay:2s; } .ds-answer-running-light span:nth-child(3) { bottom:0; left:0; width:100%; height:2px; background:linear-gradient(to left,#3b2e27,#dfb76f); animation:ds-running-light-bottom 2s linear infinite; animation-delay:1s; } .ds-answer-running-light span:nth-child(4) { top:0; left:0; width:2px; height:100%; background:linear-gradient(to top,#3b2e27,#dfb76f); animation:ds-running-light-left 2s linear infinite; animation-delay:2s; } @keyframes ds-running-light-top { 0% { transform:translateX(-100%); } 100% { transform:translateX(100%); } } @keyframes ds-running-light-right { 0% { transform:translateY(-100%); } 100% { transform:translateY(100%); } } @keyframes ds-running-light-bottom { 0% { transform:translateX(100%); } 100% { transform:translateX(-100%); } } @keyframes ds-running-light-left { 0% { transform:translateY(100%); } 100% { transform:translateY(-100%); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-answer-running-light { display:none !important; } .ds-answer-selected { border-color:#f0d0aa; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #dfb58e; } }

narrative.overview:
Nocturna feels like opening a small illustrated fantasy bestiary after dark. Original creature portraits provide the spectacle; the interface acts as a restrained charcoal and copper frame around each choice and revelation. The visual language is game-like and ceremonial, but the interaction stays direct enough for a seven-minute quiz.

The same world spans the landing page, one-question-at-a-time quiz, and result. Fine copper borders, four extended square corners on each major frame, heraldic icons, and MedievalSharp connect those screens. Dense ornament lives at the edges and around milestones, leaving answer text and result stories easy to scan. A selected answer carries the only continuous animation: four clipped, gold-tipped gradients travel along its edges.
keyCharacteristics: Original retro-fantasy creature portraits are the focal imagery.
Charcoal surfaces and warm copper strokes establish the dark RPG mood.
Four-corner copper frames repeat around portraits, quiz panels, and result panels.
A selected answer shows a moving gold edge light, with a static border for reduced motion.
Responsive layouts keep the answer path and result reading order simple.

rules.name: The Copper Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Use copper for the primary action and decisive details; let muted text and frame edges handle supporting information.

rules.name: The One-Face Rule
rules.body: Keep the fantasy face across headings, choices, and controls; use size and spacing to distinguish their jobs.

rules.name: The Single Decision Rule
rules.body: Present one question at a time in one central frame; keep the five answers in a consistent vertical scan path.

rules.name: The Fine Frame Rule
rules.body: Place four separate square-and-line ornaments around important surfaces; keep their strokes thin and the surrounding charcoal space open.

rules.name: The Input Modality Rule
rules.body: Reveal focus outlines after `keydown` and hide them after `pointerdown`; selected-answer light remains a separate state.

dos: Do let the creature art remain the visual focal point and keep its frame thin.
Do use the copper primary action consistently for advancing or sharing.
Do preserve a single-column answer list and distinct selected, disabled, hover, and keyboard-only focus states.
Do keep the selected-answer edge lights as the only continuous motion, and replace them with a static bright border under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
donts: Don't introduce rounded card shapes into the square-framed quiz and result surfaces.
Don't use the red, blue, or green trait colors as competing page-level accents.
Don't crowd the ornate frame with extra controls or decorative copy around the answer path.
